---
title: "Workflow: soil fauna metabarcoding"
---

From soil sample to sequence data. Each box is a protocol; click a box or a row to open it.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A["Sampling, MacFadyen extraction, sorting<br/>EnGeL-FAUNA-MAR-MORPH"] --> B["DNA extraction<br/>EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG (robot)<br/>or EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-COL (columns)"]
  B --> C["Nucleic acid QC<br/>EnGeL-MOLB-NAQC"]
  C --> D["Library preparation<br/>EnGeL-MOLB-MB"]
  D --> E["Library quantification<br/>EnGeL-MOLB-KAPA"]
  E --> F["Sequencing submission<br/>(Lab Pipeline workbook)"]
  F --> G["Bioinformatics<br/>EnGeL-BIOINF-OBITOOLS4"]
  click A "../protocols/fauna/EnGeL-FAUNA-MAR-MORPH.html"
  click B "../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG.html"
  click C "../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-NAQC.html"
  click D "../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-MB.html"
  click E "../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-KAPA.html"
  click G "../protocols/bioinf/EnGeL-BIOINF-OBITOOLS4.html"
```

| Step | Protocol | Status |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1. Sampling, MacFadyen extraction, sorting | [EnGeL-FAUNA-MAR-MORPH](../protocols/fauna/EnGeL-FAUNA-MAR-MORPH.qmd) | draft |
| 2. DNA extraction | [EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-MAG.qmd) (magnetic beads) or [EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-COL](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-COL.qmd) (spin columns) | draft |
| 3. DNA quality control | [EnGeL-MOLB-NAQC](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-NAQC.qmd) | draft |
| 4. Library preparation | [EnGeL-MOLB-MB](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-MB.qmd) | draft |
| 5. Library quantification | [EnGeL-MOLB-KAPA](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-KAPA.qmd) (also inside EnGeL-MOLB-MB) | draft |
| 6. Sequencing submission | *Novogene_Submission* sheet of the Lab Pipeline workbook (see EnGeL-MOLB-MB) | – |
| 7. Bioinformatics | [EnGeL-BIOINF-OBITOOLS4](../protocols/bioinf/EnGeL-BIOINF-OBITOOLS4.qmd) | draft |

Other protocols: [EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-BARC](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-BARC.qmd) (single specimens for barcoding), [EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-BEE](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-DNA-BEE.qmd) (honey bee guts), [EnGeL-MOLB-RNA](../protocols/molb/EnGeL-MOLB-RNA.qmd) (total RNA).
